module: Career tutorial step 7 ("bigmap"): learning the big map. The player opens it, reads a popup (v2/bigmapTutorial), selects the garage point of interest (tutorial_apm_parking), sets a route to it (within 10 m of the garageExteriorPark spot), then closes the map; the next step activates 1 s later. A help message about the timeslip is displayed in the timeslipHint zone when the map is closed.
notes: The toggleBigMap action is unlocked for the step (blockedActionsTemplates.bigMap = false).
When leaving the zone, the vehicle is teleported to the beforeDragStrip spot.
The hooks onActivateBigMapCallback / onDeactivateBigMapCallback / onPoiSelectedFromBigmap / onSetBigmapNavFocus are emitted by the big map; they are ignored if the current step is not 07bigmap.

setup.desc: Called on activation: resets the objectives, unlocks the big map, activates the drivingToDragBounds and dragStripBounds zones, displays the "open the big map" message and clears the raw POIs.

onCareerTutorialLeftBounds.desc: Out-of-bounds hook: starts the step's out-of-bounds reset.

onActivateBigMapCallback.desc: Hook emitted when the big map opens: hides the timeslip help and, on the first opening, opens the v2/bigmapTutorial popup after 0.5 s.

onDeactivateBigMapCallback.desc: Hook emitted when the big map closes: if the route is set, validates the close objective and advances the step after 1 s.

onIntroPopupCareerClosed.desc: Popup close hook: when v2/bigmapTutorial closes, displays the POI selection objective.

onPoiSelectedFromBigmap.desc: Hook emitted when a POI is selected: validates the objective if it is the garage POI.

onSetBigmapNavFocus.desc: Hook emitted when a route is set on the map: validates the objective if the destination is within 10 m of the garage.

onUpdate.desc: Called every frame: shows or hides the timeslip help message depending on whether the player is in the timeslipHint zone, within bounds and the map is closed.

cleanup.desc: Removes the zone reset, the timeslip message and the task list.

onDebugMenu.desc: Displays the step state and a "Skip Step 7" button.
